SELECT 
  fished_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / CAST(SUM(anglers) AS FLOAT), 2) as yt_per_angler,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / CAST(SUM(anglers) AS FLOAT) * 1000 / 550, 1) as roi_per_1000_on_1p5day
FROM trips
WHERE cls = 'day_1_5'
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY yt_per_angler DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
  fished_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / CAST(SUM(anglers) AS FLOAT), 2) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 2 AND fished_date_doy <= 50
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fished_date_doy;
